property.name: useProvidedMappings
property.label: Use Provided Mappings
property.description: If true, use mappingsJson input instead of querying saved mappings.

property.name: mappingsJson
property.label: Mappings JSON
property.description: JSON array of mapping rows to prepopulate the UI.

property.name: useSessionDraft
property.label: Use Session Draft
property.description: If true, persist in-progress rows in session storage.

property.name: mappingsOutputJson
property.label: Mappings Output JSON
property.description: JSON array of mapping rows after Save.

property.name: deletedIdsJson
property.label: Deleted Ids JSON
property.description: JSON array of deleted mapping record Ids.
